name: domain-agents
description: Domain agents and session skills built from the former CDP5 knowledge-pack roles: marketing-strategist, psy-domaenen-rechercheur and psy-grenzwaechter as agents; business-lingo, psy-knowledge, psy-diagnostik-navigator, psy-therapiebegleiter, psy-paar-moderator, marketing-knowledge and ux-knowledge as skills with their knowledge packs shipped as supporting files. Requires the cdp5-agents plugin for the worker contract hooks; without it the agents stop with CONTRACT-MISSING (own SubagentStart guard).
